invariants: observations.parquet carries no truth column (enforced at write time)
no observed value is an entity id (enforced at write time)
record_id is a hash of (world_id, source, sequence) and holds no entity information

exclusions: not a population register or demographic estimate
no real people, accounts, or company identifiers
Ghana corridor profile is a subsequent release

provenance.filtered: 7864 entries not tagged NG, and 477 NG-tagged entries that are not names (Wikidata blank-node URLs, property labels, administrative areas, and labels carrying a qualifier such as 'surname'); see arche_synthetic.lexicon
provenance.method: occurrence_count weighting among NG-tagged, filtered name tokens
provenance.note: occurrence_count is source evidence, not a Nigerian population frequency estimate; it is a reproducible collision prior, not a demographic claim.

provenance.method: context-weighted family and cohort-conditioned given-name draw
provenance.note: contexts and cohort weights are not demographic estimates; the asset exists to make name-part correlation explicit and reviewable.

provenance.method: generate-and-validate; every identifier passes at build time
